news.title: How the SEC’s lack of leadership could facilitate crypto rulemaking
news.summary: A recent change in the SEC’s rules on quorum could make it easier for the agency to amend its approach to crypto regulation in the absence of a market structure bill.

news.title: Ripple, Stripe-owned Privy partner to bring embedded wallets to XRP Ledger
news.summary: Developers can now build XRPL wallets into apps via Privy, with support for XRP, RLUSD, AI agent payments and x402.

news.title: Strive reports $208M in warrant exercises as Bitcoin holdings jump 11%
news.summary: Strive is now the fifth-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder, with 32,773 BTC, as it continues to expand its treasury through equity financing.

news.title: Crypto exchange MNX takes on OKX, BitGet offering pre-IPO futures for AI giants
news.summary: MNX is offering a different way to trade the future valuations of private AI companies, including OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek.

news.title: Bitcoin keeps up pressure on $84K as US stocks skirt Korea tech sell-off
news.summary: Bitcoin price action preserved overnight gains as US stocks quickly rebounded after opening lower on the back of Korea’s tech-stock rout.

news.title: UK crypto trader says almost $800,000 lost in knife attack as wrench attacks proliferate
news.summary: A crypto trader in the U.K. claimed masked intruders stole nearly $800,000 in cryptocurrency at knifepoint, furthering concerns of "wrench attacks" spreading in the country.

news.title: Interactive Brokers expands crypto services with Ethereum staking via Zerohash
news.summary: Interactive Brokers now lets eligible clients stake ETH through its Client Portal, with zerohash providing the service.

news.title: DRW and Marex complete OTC swap referencing tokenized S&P iBoxx Index
news.summary: DRW and Marex completed the first OTC swap referencing a fully tokenized index on Derivnex via the Canton Network, with Kaiko data.

news.title: Ledger confirms hardware implant in CryptoBilis reseller units as MediaMarkt suspends sales in Europe
news.summary: Ledger confirmed a hardware implant in CryptoBilis-sold devices steals recovery phrases, as MediaMarkt suspends sales.

news.title: Anthropic warns ‘AI worms’ may autonomously spread across devices like a virus
news.summary: Anthropic warned that rogue “AI worms” are months away from the ability to self-replicate and autonomously infect user devices such as home appliances and other internet-connected devices.

news.title: Strive buys 3,311 bitcoin for $280 million in largest acquisition since January
news.summary: Strive added 3,311 BTC between Oct. 5 and Oct. 9, bringing holdings to 32,773 BTC and narrowing the gap with MARA.

news.title: Is Bitcoin kidding itself about the Lightning Network?
news.summary: Bitcoin developer Paul Sztorc says Bitcoiners are lying to themselves about Lightning. Developers claim usability has improved, but questions remain over everyday adoption.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Digital cash offers ‘cash-like privacy,’ but bank data breaches threaten users: BIS
news.summary: BIS said that digital cash can achieve “cash-like privacy,” however, the technology isn’t yet production-ready due to risks such as bank data breaches.

news.title: Russia clears Sberbank for crypto trading ahead of December launch
news.summary: Russia’s largest bank, Sberbank, has secured crypto exchange authorization as it prepares to offer Bitcoin, Ether and Tether USDt trading.

news.title: South Korea blocks 27 crypto exchanges, including Bitmart and Kucoin
news.summary: The country’s regulators are stepping up their earlier restrictions on mobile apps to websites, targeting unregistered exchanges before investors report losses.

news.title: Federated Hermes joins Wall Street's tokenization push with plans for first onchain fund shares
news.summary: The $911 billion Pittsburgh-based asset manager is teaming up with Prometheum to bring blockchain-based share classes of its funds to traditional brokerage accounts.

news.title: Binance to shut down mining pool, cloud mining and related services
news.summary: Binance said it will shut down its mining pool, cloud mining, and Pool Savings services on Nov. 10.

news.title: UK High Court rules Chinese law governs claims over $5 billion in seized bitcoin
news.summary: A UK judge ruled Chinese law applies to victims' claims over 61,000 seized bitcoin, leaving ownership undecided.

news.title: Stacks' STX, a Bitcoin layer-2 token, has surged by 50% in four weeks
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 13, 2026

news.title: ENS seeks DAO approval to activate upgraded Ethereum naming system
news.summary: New .eth registrations would pause for hours during the transition, while existing domain holders could renew their names without migrating.

news.title: Bitcoin, ether slip and rebound as South Korean stocks slide on AI-related concerns
news.summary: Investors are positioning ahead of today's bank earnings reports and Wednesday’s U.S. inflation data.

news.title: Russia’s largest bank Sberbank secures approval to trade crypto
news.summary: Sberbank plans to open crypto trading to all clients Dec. 1 and is already testing BTC, ETH and USDT trades in its app.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin trading in tight range near $83,000 ahead of key U.S. inflation data
news.summary: The September CPI report comes out on Wednesday, with economists expecting a sizable increase in the headline number but a softening in the core rate.

news.title: Bitcoin diverges from South Korean stocks as AI concerns deepen the Kospi selloff

news.summary: Metaplanet plans to issue zero-interest bonds with a five-year maturity to improve its debt structure and cut its reliance on Bitcoin-collateralized loans without selling holdings.

news.title: MediaMarktSaturn pulls Ledger products amid tampering reports
news.summary: European retailer MediaMarkt pulled Ledger products as the wallet maker probes tampering reports beyond CryptoBilis in Southeast Asia.

news.title: Bitcoin hits $84K resistance as Korean tech rout deepens KOSPI losses
news.summary: Bitcoin’s liquidity kept BTC price below $84,000 amid a mounting South Korean tech and semiconductor stock sell-off.

news.summary: Ledger announced MediaMarket Saturn stopped selling devices after a customer found a corrupted signer in Germany.

news.title: UK court ruling boosts government’s chances of keeping $5 billion in seized bitcoin
news.summary: The decision concerns 61,000 BTC seized by the Metropolitan Police in its investigation into Zhimin Qian, who pleaded guilty to defrauding thousands of people in China.

news.title: Chinese fraud victims lose key court battle over 61,000 Bitcoin
news.summary: Chinese fraud victims seeking to recover 61,000 seized Bitcoin face a legal setback after a UK court ruled that Chinese law governs their claims.

news.title: Ledger details LTE-enabled spy implants in wallets sold by CryptoBilis
news.summary: Ledger detailed how LTE-enabled implants exposed wallet recovery phrases as CryptoBilis halted sales and Trezor and OneKey cut ties with the reseller.

news.title: Bitcoin whale that sat through the March 2020 crash moves $378 million
news.summary: A bitcoin whale that received coins days before the Covid crash and sat through it has moved millions on-chain.

news.title: Binance VIP head says hedge funds are actively exploring arbitrage opportunities on crypto venues
news.summary: The executive cited improved depth, 24/7 trading and weekend price discovery as reasons why the opportunities have become more relevant.

news.title: Blur is shutting down its website, so why are NFT collectors cheering?
news.summary: Blur’s planned website closure revived criticism of the royalty policies and token rewards that helped it overtake OpenSea during the NFT boom, but hurt creators.

news.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million

news.title: Binance to shut down crypto mining pool services in November
news.summary: Binance will discontinue its mining pool and related services on Nov. 10, urging miners to move to alternative pools before the shutdown.

news.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%

news.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000, decoupling from tumbling Korean stocks
news.summary: Bitcoin climbed back above $83,000 after an early dip, decoupling from a sharp slide in Korean chip stocks and weakness in Nasdaq futures ahead of Thursday’s US CPI report.

news.title: Bitcoin whale moves $378 million in BTC after six years of dormancy: onchain data
news.summary: The wallet originally received 4,582 BTC in March 2020, when the holdings were worth roughly $40.8 million.

news.title: South Korea moves to block 27 crypto websites, including KuCoin, MEXC
news.summary: Authorities said the restrictions are aimed at unregistered exchanges and have acknowledged that customers could have difficulty withdrawing assets.

news.title: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as crypto liquidations surge past $770 million
news.summary: Crypto liquidations amounted to $771 million over the past 24 hours, including $685.6 million in long positions.

news.title: Meta claims new Muse Wonder AI models rival OpenAI, Anthropic
news.summary: Meta co-founder Mark Zuckerberg said its newest models are a step toward “personal superintelligence.”

news.summary: The optional feature hides transaction details until their order is finalized, preventing bots from exploiting pending trades.

news.title: Blur to shut down frontend next month as NFT trading volume dwindles

news.title: FTX’s crypto mining venture is now used to advance AI

news.title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo
news.summary: A Tempo report examines how proposed US accounting rules could change corporate stablecoin holdings, with direct redemption rights determining which tokens qualify as cash.

news.title: StoneX raises Securitize price target 50% as tokenized stock platform opens new revenue stream

news.title: Bitcoin miners face widening AI financing costs as lenders scrutinize deals

news.title: Bitcoin drops 2.2% as Ukraine, Iran strikes send oil toward one-month high
news.summary: Bitcoin price action stayed rangebound after failing to sustain above $84,000 into the Wall Street open on rising oil prices.

news.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet

news.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether

news.title: Tokenized catastrophe bonds target the disaster-insurance gap

news.title: DeFi Development grows SOL holdings 12% as CHAD hits record highs

news.title: XRP treasury Evernorth’s shares rise 5% at Nasdaq opening print
news.summary: Evernorth’s share price rose by 5% as investors welcomed the Nasdaq debut of the first pure-play XRP digital asset treasury.

news.title: Bitmine adds 12,532 ETH as Tom Lee flags potential ‘largest-ever’ crypto bull market
news.summary: Bitmine (BMNR) added 12,532 ETH last week, lifting its Ethereum treasury to 6.03 million tokens, or 4.9% of supply, with 84% staked.

news.title: ‘There’s always room for more orange’: Michael Saylor’s Strategy scoops up another 250 bitcoin for $21.5 million as holdings reach 848,250 BTC
news.summary: Strategy's total holdings account for around 4% of the 21 million bitcoin supply cap — worth roughly $71 billion.

news.title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
news.summary: Ripple previously gave LMAX $150 million in financing to integrate RLUSD into its institutional infrastructure.

news.title: Ledger claims CryptoBilis cases are limited as up to $93 million is traced, $10 million frozen
news.summary: Ledger said every confirmed case involves devices sold by the Southeast Asian reseller, but critics say the hardware-wallet maker must answer for an authorized sales channel.

news.summary: Evernorth plans to put its XRP holdings to work through lending, liquidity provision and yield strategies.

news.title: Bitcoin falls below $83,000 as dollar strength keeps markets on edge
news.summary: Bitcoin and gold hold steady as a firm dollar and rising bond yields weigh on sentiment, while IREN secures a multiyear cloud services deal with Anthropic.

news.title: Global financial watchdog calls for cross-border information sharing, planning for stablecoin crisis
news.summary: Coins jointly issued by multiple companies can trap reserves in one jurisdiction while redemption demands hit another, complicating cross-border crisis response.

news.title: South Korea just got its first traditional bank loans backed by bitcoin
news.summary: Loans use third-party custodians for bitcoin holdings and rely on court-ordered sales if borrowers default.

news.title: SWI raises $894 million to repurpose former FTX bitcoin miner Genesis Digital to AI
news.summary: SWI Group said it would use the proceeds from an 800 million-euro ($894 million) fundraise to transform Genesis Digital Assets, acquired from the FTX bankruptcy, from a bitcoin miner to an AI-focused data center.

news.title: Altcoins rally on thin trading as bitcoin holds below $83,500
news.summary: The CoinDesk 80 has risen around 3% in 24 hours, more than double the CoinDesk 5, while spot bitcoin ETFs lost $681 million last week.

news.title: Morgan Stanley expects to support tokenized equities in Q1 2027, digital asset strategy head says
news.summary: Morgan Stanley is actively building the necessary infrastructure for tokenized equities while monitoring industry developments.
